# fw-rag-core crate

> Pure, wasm32-safe core of the aphrody RAG layer: source-aware chunkers (Rust/JS-TS/Markdown/structural/prose), reciprocal-rank-fusion + MMR + vector helpers…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/fw-rag-core/

Pure, wasm32-safe core of the aphrody RAG layer: source-aware chunkers (Rust/JS-TS/Markdown/structural/prose), reciprocal-rank-fusion + MMR + vector helpers, and a bit-for-bit port of shenron's retrieval eval harness.
